title: Whisper in the Dark
narration: Somewhere out there, a 722-kilogram machine is calling home. Its voice? A faint 23-watt whisper, barely a nightlight.
visual_goal: Dark starfield, a tiny blinking light in the distance, radio waves pulsing.

title: Launch of a Dream
narration: September 5, 1977. Cape Canaveral. A rocket lifts, carrying a gold-plated record of Earth's sounds and images.
visual_goal: Historical launch footage, liftoff, the Golden Record close-up.

title: Giants and Fire
narration: It flew past Jupiter in 1979, finding volcanoes on Io. Then Saturn, 1980. A journey of firsts.
visual_goal: Jupiter and Io volcanic eruption, Saturn ring flyby animation.

title: Into the Beyond
narration: August 25, 2012. It crossed the heliopause—first human object in interstellar space. Now, 24.9 billion kilometers away.
visual_goal: Animated crossing of a boundary, transition to starry interstellar space, distance graphic.

title: The Long Silence
narration: By 2030, it will fall silent. But it will keep sailing—a message in a bottle, for anyone, or no one, to find.
visual_goal: Voyager drifting away, fading light, Earth in distance, poetic shot.
